features.name: applicant_log_income_norm
features.description: Log-transformed annual income scaled by training-fold minimum and maximum income values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces income skew and gives the linear SVM a bounded capacity signal.

features.name: loan_amount_log_norm
features.description: Log-transformed requested principal scaled by training-fold principal bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures requested size on a stable scale while limiting influence of large amounts.

features.name: income_loan_log_headroom
features.description: Log income minus log requested principal, normalized by training-fold span; larger values indicate greater income cushion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an approximate linear affordability projection that combines capacity and requested size.

features.name: loan_income_share_norm
features.description: Requested principal as a fraction of income, scaled by the observed upper bound of loan_percent_income.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a direct smooth debt-burden severity measure for margin placement.

features.name: interest_rate_norm
features.description: Interest rate scaled to the training-fold observed range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes pricing severity on a bounded linear scale.

features.name: credit_score_norm
features.description: Credit score scaled to the training-fold observed score range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the SVM a monotonic credit-quality axis.

features.name: human_capital_maturity_score
features.description: Composite of education level and employment experience relative to plausible adult years.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines education and work history into one smooth stability coordinate.

features.name: credit_history_depth_score
features.description: Composite of absolute credit history length and share of adult years with recorded history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a bounded maturity signal that can complement credit score.

features.name: repayment_pressure_composite
features.description: Weighted blend of income share, interest-rate severity, and prior default indicator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Precomputes a nonlinear burden interaction useful for a linear margin.

features.name: housing_default_stability_score
features.description: Row-level stability score from home status and absence of prior default.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses sparse housing one-hots and payment-history flag into a compact support signal.
features.formula: np.clip(0.60 * home_own + 0.45 * home_mortgage + 0.20 * home_other + 0.05 * home_rent + 0.25 * defaults_no, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: purpose_productivity_semantic_score
features.description: Numeric semantic review of loan purpose using only intent_* one-hot fields. Assign 0.0 to 1.0, with higher values for purposes plausibly linked to earning capacity or durable assets, middle values for mixed or discretionary uses, and lower values for emergency or liability-management uses.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal purpose axis so the linear SVM can use business meaning in addition to sparse intent indicators.

features.name: repayment_concern_semantic_score
features.description: Numeric review of overall repayment concern from principal size, income share, interest rate, credit score, prior default flags, housing status, employment experience, education, and credit history length. 0.0 means minimal concern; 1.0 means severe concern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures expert-style severity cues in one bounded coordinate that can shift the margin when multiple weak concerns align.
